title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Processing a Signed Cancellation
content:
Processing a cancellation on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) ends the policy on the cancellation effective date and leaves it cancelled, books a cancellation credit for the risk premium referencing the signed cancellation request, and, when the policy is mortgage-required, sends written notice of the cancellation to the mortgagee of record on the date it is processed.

**Open claims.** A cancellation is not processed until no claim on the policy is open, every coverage measured on the latest adjuster report for each date of loss on the policy carrying a payment or a written denial for that date of loss dated after that report. While any coverage measured on the latest adjuster report for a date of loss on the policy carries neither a payment nor a written denial for that date of loss dated after that report, a claim on the policy is open and the cancellation is not processed.

## Capability

The processing records the cancellation on the policy — status cancelled, the request's reason, the given cancellation effective date and the processing date — books the risk premium cancellation credit referencing the request (none is booked when the credit is zero), and on a mortgage-required policy records the written notice sent that day to the mortgagee of record. The policy's premium balance falls by the credit booked. No money is paid out by this action.

## Invocation

The tool is `process_cancellation_a892a1e4`, an agent-side tool that the agent unlocks and then calls.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nfipcom_policy_id` | the reference number of the policy being cancelled, as returned by the policy lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `nfipcom_request_id` | the reference number of the signed cancellation request on file for the policy, as returned by the cancellation request lookup | identifier |
| `cancellation_effective_date` | the date the cancellation takes effect | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `risk_credit` | the risk premium cancellation credit | USD, zero or positive, 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to the cent |

## Receipt

`policy_status` (cancelled), `cancellation_reason` (copied from the request), `cancellation_effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `risk_credit` (the credit booked, 2 decimal places), `mortgagee_notified` (the mortgagee of record named on the notice, or empty text when the policy is not mortgage-required) and `premium_balance` (the policy balance after the credit; negative means money due back to the payor). A `policy_status` of cancelled means the processing is done. No error behaviour is defined.
